title: Ambient and Poincaré metrics for CR $3$-manifolds associated with the self-dual Einstein ACH metric
summary: We construct new ambient and Poincaré metrics for the Fefferman conformal manifold over $3$-dimensional CR manifolds, starting from the associated self-dual Einstein ACH metric. Unlike the classical ambient and Poincaré metrics arising from approximate solutions to the complex Monge-Ampère equation, these metrics satisfy Einstein-Maxwell-type equations to infinite order rather than the Ricci-flat or Einstein equations.
